steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: Observational drawing means working from direct looking — not imagination or photographs (unless for specific purpose). | Key Fact: Sight-size measuring helps you judge proportions accurately by comparing sizes at arm's length with a pencil or thread. | Key Fact: Linear perspective creates the illusion of depth: one-point for front-facing views, two-point for corners, aerial for distance. | Key Fact: Foreshortening describes how objects appear shorter when angled towards or away from the viewer.
